video_title: MICHAEL BEASLEY CONFRONTS DELONTE WEST BEFORE THEIR FIGHT

quotes.speaker: Michael Beasley
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Beasley on his shared history with Delonte West
quotes.excerpt: we grew up together, we played against each other in the NBA, we played on the same teams
quotes.quote: It is nothing. We grew up together, we played against each other in the NBA, we played on the same teams, AAU, streetball, Shanghai. We have been in scuffles before in the locker rooms, playing one-on-ones, just like matching up against some of the guys you never thought you would match up against, like Kobe Bryant or matching up against LeBron James in practice. Nobody is scared. It is what it is.

quotes.speaker: Michael Beasley
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Beasley on his family's history with boxing
quotes.excerpt: I grew up boxing underneath CeCe Anderson and Mark Anderson, my uncles, man, and my uncle Rudy
quotes.quote: I am confident in my abilities as an athlete and a competitor. I grew up boxing underneath CeCe Anderson and Mark Anderson, my uncles, man, and my uncle Rudy, and my mother was a boxer. My mother could do karate and fight. My brother Dino, he was in the boxing ring. We come from a history of boxers and karate and all sorts of martial arts. Growing up in D.C., you have to know how to scramble a little bit anyway.

quotes.speaker: Michael Beasley
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Beasley on a potential fight with LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I just got to see them, they got to see me
quotes.quote: I just got to see them, they got to see me.

quotes.speaker: Michael Beasley
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Beasley on his recent collaboration with Neon
quotes.excerpt: Neon is doing amazing things, not just in the stream world, man, he is doing amazing things
quotes.quote: Amazing, man. Bless his heart, man. Neon is doing amazing things, not just in the stream world, man, he is doing amazing things across the world, man. Sometimes God uses you, and I know he uses you as it looks like one avenue, but it is a door to open up different things. And the Lord is definitely using him to not only lead by example in the stream world, but he is also changing lives, man.

quotes.speaker: Michael Beasley
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Beasley on his past struggles with substance abuse
quotes.excerpt: I have always self-medicated growing up with things most youth do
quotes.quote: I have always self-medicated growing up with things most youth do. Nothing serious, no hard narcotics or anything heavy. But my mother always told me those are gateways. One big one eventually leads to a bottle of liquor. And if you had your first beer at the cookout at the family reunion, you snuck one out of the cooler, you and your cousins, eventually it led to another beer, and that led to another smoke, and another smoke.

quotes.speaker: Michael Beasley
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Beasley on his post-NBA scouting career
quotes.excerpt: I was an NBA scout with the Celtics for about four years
quotes.quote: After I was done playing, Danny Ainge and the Boston Celtics, I was an NBA scout with the Celtics for about four years. They would send me around to all the colleges up and down the East Coast. And I had coaching opportunities during this time. Mr. Cuban, Mark Cuban, he offered me a coaching job with the developmental team out there, the G League team, the Texas Legends.

quotes.speaker: Michael Beasley
quotes.summary_phrase: Delonte West on his upcoming fight with Michael Beasley

text_blocks.speaker: Fred
text_blocks.text: I am reunited with Michael Beasley. Michael, good to see you again, man. The last time I saw you was after you had your fight in the USApex, and you are back again on BrandRisk. You are not excited?

text_blocks.speaker: Delonte West
text_blocks.text: Yeah, I am kind of scared.

quotes.speaker: Delonte West
quotes.summary_phrase: Delonte West on his past fight with Michael Beasley
quotes.excerpt: See, Lance is pretty good about it, you know, we were teammates, so we had something bigger
quotes.quote: See, Lance is pretty good about it, you know, we were teammates, so we had something bigger to focus on. But my comments were not too friendly. People call me a minute man and stuff like that. I feel like I lasted longer than a minute. But I do not like the fact that he choked me. I do not like MMA.
